Pearls are typically found in oysters.

Regarding the operational processes at Fashion Forward, the primary bottleneck is the outdated First-In-First-Out (FIFO) storage system. This system creates inefficiency because newer stock is placed behind older items, making it difficult to access recent inventory. Consequently, the warehouse incurs significant time costs due to the need for reorganization whenever the latest inventory is required for shipment. An efficiency improvement would involve implementing a more flexible storage system, such as a dynamic slotting strategy or a warehouse management system that optimizes pick paths, allowing direct access to newer items without disturbing older stock.
